items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: he took lessons from Charlie McCurtis

ctx.x: Walter Brundy. And that's what you said? Yeah, he took lessons from Charlie McCurtis. He was a drum and he was playing baronet and he came over. That's Brundy got killed by the... Well, that's what you...
